title: epiphyllum anguligerum
intro: Epiphyllum anguligerum, commonly known as the "Queen of the Night" or "Night-Blooming Cereus," is a species of epiphytic cactus native to Mexico. This plant is known for its unique, funnel-shaped flowers that bloom only at night and wither before dawn, providing a short yet striking display. The health benefits of Epiphyllum anguligerum include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and glycosides, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedative and anti-anxiety effects.
